Planting design

More life, in every season.

For a garden with a layout you like, but planting that could work harder. We choose plants for your soil, light and the amount of time you want to spend caring for them.

What’s included

A clear scope.
No guesswork.

  • Review of existing beds, light and soil
  • Scaled planting plan and plant schedule
  • Seasonal interest and maintenance notes
  • One follow-up conversation after planting

Planting plans from £650

Typical timing: 2–4 weeks

Ask about this service

How it works

We look at what is already thriving before proposing changes. Repeated groups make the planting feel settled, with enough variety to bring interest through the year. You receive a schedule showing what to buy and where to put it.

Before you book

Plants, soil testing and installation are not included in the design fee. Pricing depends on the size and complexity of the beds.
